answer: Clone keys often share one quarry invoice. Mechanism: book an 11-min slot at a published marble bench. Drive a 48 g ferrous pin to depth (H(pubkey||bench_id||slot) mod 17)+9 mm, then record the block's acoustic kernel; the third flexural peak must hit that hash's 40 Hz bin (1.80-2.52 kHz). Cost is 89 locked units. Three peers replay the depth gauge and spectrogram and drop any refund path already on a live bench. A depth miss over 0.6 mm, a kernel off-bin, or a reused bench-id burns 25 units and cools the key eight epochs; a second miss or cloned spectrogram forfeits the lock for 15 epochs.
